description: Clock-synced envelope generator: ping it a tempo, and it puts out an envelope at a division or multiple of that time

params.text: Sets the envelope's period against the pinged time, in nineteen steps from a thirty-second of it up to sixteen times it
Sweeps the envelope's shape from a ramp rising across the whole period, through a symmetrical peak in the middle, to a ramp falling across it, bending the slopes on the way
Sets the height of the ENV output, up to 10V peak to peak
Shifts the ENV output up or down
Tap it twice to set the time the envelope is built from
Sets the envelope cycling, so it starts again as soon as it finishes

inputs.text: Two edges above 2V set the time the envelope is built from
A rising edge above 2V fires one envelope, and what an edge here means is chosen on the menu
Moves the SHAPE setting; 5V takes it to the bottom of the range and -5V to the top
Switches cycling on and off; whether an edge or a level does it is chosen on the menu
Moves the DIV/MULT setting; 5V takes it to the bottom of the range and -5V to the top

outputs.text: The envelope after SCALE and OFFSET, running between -10V and +10V
A 5V pulse or gate at the point in the cycle chosen on the menu
The envelope at a fixed 0V to 5V, with SCALE and OFFSET passing it by

notes: The number of voices follows whichever of the ping, trigger and cycle jacks has the most channels, up to four.
menu: Sync Mode: Sync, Async — chooses whether the envelope re-locks to the pinged clock every cycle or runs on from the last ping
Shift — moves the whole envelope up or down in voltage, on top of the OFFSET knob
Skew Limit: Off, On — holds the shape control back from the extreme skews that leave one side of the envelope too short to hear
Free-running Ping: On, Off — chooses whether the envelope keeps running between pings or stops after the last one
EOF Jack Type: Gate, Trigger — chooses whether that jack puts out a short pulse or a gate
EOF Jack Mode: EOR, EOF, Half-Rise, Tap Clock — chooses what the jack marks: the end of the rise, the end of the fall, the halfway point of the rise, or the tapped clock itself
Cycle Jack Mode: Trig, Gate+Sync, Gate — chooses how the cycle jack is read: a rising edge toggles cycling, both edges toggle it in step with the clock, or both edges toggle it
Trig Jack Mode: Async Trig, Async Gate, Quantized Trig — chooses how the trigger jack is read: fire at once, fire and hold while the gate is high, or hold off until the next beat
